summary: Grupo Aeroportuario del Sureste (ASUR) filed a Form 6-K with an exhibit titled 'ASUR Announces Total Passenger Traffic for June 2026'. The release reports a 5.8% year-over-year decline in total passenger traffic to 5.6 million, with decreases in Mexico (-8.5%), Puerto Rico (-4.6%), and Colombia (-1.1%). The filing is a routine monthly operational update on passenger volumes, not a special situation. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, strategic review, or other corporate event is disclosed. This is a standard foreign private issuer report of operational data, akin to an earnings release or traffic report, and contains no actionable event-driven transaction.
